candidates.statement: Checkout 502s stem from downstream latency: order's POST payment call to payment /v1/authorizations fails with transport ReadTimeout (~2s), propagating 502 to /v1/orders and /v1/checkout. Inventory/redis calls succeed quickly, isolating the slow hop to payment.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side telemetry absent; whether payment is slow or unreachable is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show consistent ReadTimeout on order->payment authorizations while inventory/redis succeed, and gateway /v1/checkout 502s with ~2.4s p95. Topology confirms order->payment dependency. Bounded to downstream-latency at the payment hop; payment-side metrics/logs would confirm.
